name_en: Grilled Chicken with Rice and Baladi Salad
name_ar: دجاج مشوي مع أرز وسلطة بلدي
aliases: ["Egyptian grilled chicken and rice", "Chicken rice salad"]
instructions: Season chicken with lemon, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; grill until cooked through; serve with cooked rice and a tomato-cucumber baladi salad.

name_en: Shish Tawook with Rice and Grilled Vegetables
name_ar: شيش طاووق مع أرز وخضار مشوية
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes in yogurt, lemon, garlic, paprika, and spices; thread onto skewers and grill; serve with rice and grilled peppers, onion, and zucchini.

name_en: Grilled Kofta with Baladi Salad and Tahini
name_ar: كفتة مشوية مع سلطة بلدي وطحينة
instructions: Mix lean minced beef with grated onion, parsley, salt, pepper, and spices; shape around skewers and grill; serve with baladi salad and a measured tahini sauce.

name_en: Grilled Tilapia with Rice and Salad
name_ar: سمك بلطي مشوي مع أرز وسلطة
instructions: Season tilapia with garlic, cumin, coriander, lemon, salt, and pepper; grill until flaky; serve with rice and fresh salad.

name_en: Baked Sea Bass with Lemon and Vegetables
instructions: Place sea bass with lemon, garlic, herbs, and a small amount of olive oil; bake until the fish flakes easily; serve with roasted vegetables.

name_en: Ful Medames with Egg and Salad
aliases: ["Foul medames with eggs", "Fava beans with egg"]
instructions: Warm cooked fava beans with cumin, garlic, lemon, and a small amount of olive oil; top with boiled egg; serve with tomato, cucumber, and herbs.
Warm fava beans with cumin, garlic, lemon, tomato, and parsley; mash lightly and finish with a small measured amount of olive oil.
Blend soaked split fava beans with herbs, onion, garlic, coriander, and cumin; shape into patties; brush lightly with oil and bake until browned and crisp.
Simmer red lentils with onion, carrot, tomato, cumin, and stock until soft; blend to the desired texture; finish with lemon.

name_en: Molokhia with Grilled Chicken and Rice
instructions: Cook molokhia in seasoned broth; prepare a garlic-coriander tempering and stir it in; serve with grilled chicken and a measured portion of rice.

name_en: Bamia with Lean Beef and Rice
instructions: Brown lean beef; simmer with tomato, garlic, spices, and okra until tender; serve with a controlled portion of cooked rice.

name_en: Basella with Lean Beef and Rice
aliases: ["Egyptian peas and carrots stew", "Peas with beef"]
instructions: Brown lean beef with onion; simmer with peas, carrots, tomato sauce, and spices until tender; serve with cooked rice.

name_en: White Bean Stew with Lean Beef
name_ar: فاصوليا بيضاء بالصلصة واللحم قليل الدهن
instructions: Cook white beans until tender; simmer with lean beef, onion, garlic, tomato sauce, and spices until the flavors combine.

name_en: Green Bean Stew with Lean Beef
instructions: Brown lean beef with onion; add green beans, tomato sauce, garlic, and spices; simmer until the meat and beans are tender.

name_en: Stuffed Zucchini with Lean Beef and Rice
instructions: Hollow zucchini; fill with a mixture of rice, lean minced beef, herbs, tomato, and spices; simmer gently in tomato broth until tender.

name_en: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice and Lean Beef
name_ar: فلفل محشي بالأرز واللحم قليل الدهن
instructions: Fill bell peppers with rice, lean minced beef, tomato, onion, herbs, and spices; bake or simmer until the peppers and rice are tender.
Cook freekeh in seasoned stock; grill or pan-sear chicken; assemble with cucumber, tomato, herbs, and a light lemon dressing.
Whisk eggs with chopped parsley, onion, tomato, peppers, and spices; cook in a lightly oiled pan or bake until set.
Quickly saute sliced beef liver with garlic, cumin, chili, vinegar, and peppers; avoid overcooking; serve with baladi salad.

name_en: Tuna with Baladi Salad and Baladi Bread
name_ar: تونة مع سلطة بلدي وعيش بلدي
aliases: ["Tuna baladi plate", "Tuna salad with Egyptian bread"]
instructions: Drain tuna and combine with lemon, pepper, parsley, tomato, cucumber, and onion; serve with a measured portion of baladi bread.
Brown lean minced beef with onion and garlic; simmer with tomato and herbs; toss or serve over cooked spaghetti.
Cook pasta until al dente; simmer tomato with garlic, basil, and a measured amount of olive oil; toss together and season.
Grill seasoned chicken; toss romaine with a moderate amount of Caesar dressing, Parmesan, and croutons; slice chicken over the salad.

name_en: Chicken Breast with Rice and Broccoli
instructions: Season and grill or pan-sear chicken breast; cook rice; steam broccoli; portion all three components evenly.

name_en: Oven Chicken with Potatoes and Vegetables
aliases: ["Chicken potato tray bake", "Baked chicken and vegetables"]
instructions: Toss chicken, potato, peppers, zucchini, onion, garlic, and spices with a small amount of oil; roast until chicken is cooked and vegetables are browned.
Cook lean beef strips with garlic and spices; saute mixed vegetables; serve over rice with a light sauce.

name_en: Baked Salmon with Potatoes and Vegetables
instructions: Season salmon with lemon, garlic, and herbs; bake with potatoes and vegetables until the salmon flakes and potatoes are tender.
Combine cooked pasta with drained tuna, cucumber, tomato, corn, herbs, lemon, and a light yogurt or olive-oil dressing; chill before serving.
Cook seasoned chicken strips with peppers and onions; serve over rice with tomato salsa and optional yogurt in place of heavy sour cream.
Fill flatbread with grilled chicken, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and a garlic-lemon yogurt sauce; roll tightly and toast briefly if desired.
Cook oats with milk until creamy; stir in cinnamon; top with sliced banana and optional measured nuts or seeds.

name_en: Greek Yogurt with Oats and Fruit
instructions: Add Greek yogurt to a bowl; top with oats, seasonal fruit, cinnamon, and a small measured amount of nuts or seeds.
Toast bread; mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper; spread on toast and top with cooked eggs.
Blend oats, banana, eggs, milk, cinnamon, and baking powder; cook small pancakes on a lightly greased nonstick pan.
Combine cooked lentils and chickpeas with tomato, cucumber, parsley, onion, and lemon; dress with a measured amount of olive oil.
Cook rice, lentils, macaroni, and chickpeas separately; layer them in bowls; top with spiced tomato sauce, garlic-vinegar sauce, and crispy fried onions.
Mix minced beef with onion, pepper, parsley, chili, and spices; stuff into baladi bread; brush lightly with fat and bake until the bread is crisp and meat is cooked.
Cook pasta; prepare seasoned minced-beef tomato filling and a creamy bechamel; layer pasta, meat, and bechamel in a baking dish; bake until set and browned.
Stretch dough very thin; fold repeatedly with butter or ghee between layers; shape into rounds and bake at high heat until puffed and deeply golden.
Layer toasted bread and rice; add garlic-vinegar tomato sauce and tender cooked beef; spoon over broth or sauce and serve hot.
Marinate sliced chicken with yogurt or vinegar, garlic, lemon, and shawarma spices; sear until browned; wrap in bread with pickles and garlic sauce.
Blend soaked fava beans with herbs, onion, garlic, coriander, and cumin; shape and deep-fry until crisp; serve in baladi bread with salad and tahini.
Break baked pastry into a dish; add nuts and raisins; pour over sweetened hot milk; top with cream and bake until bubbling and browned.
Mix semolina with yogurt, sugar, butter or ghee, and leavening; spread in a tray and bake; pour cool sugar syrup over the hot cake and rest before cutting.
Coat shredded kunafa pastry with melted butter or ghee; layer with the chosen filling; bake until crisp and golden; soak lightly with sugar syrup.
Stretch pizza dough; spread with tomato sauce; add mozzarella and basil; bake on a very hot surface until the crust is browned and cheese bubbles.
Stretch pizza dough; add tomato sauce, mozzarella, and pepperoni slices; bake at high heat until the crust is crisp and cheese is browned.
Shape seasoned ground beef into patties; grill or sear to a safe doneness; assemble in buns with vegetables, sauce, and optional cheese.
Season chicken; coat in seasoned flour or crumbs and fry until crisp and safely cooked; serve in a bun with lettuce, pickles, and sauce.
Cook pasta; sear seasoned chicken; make a creamy Parmesan sauce with butter and cream; combine pasta with sauce and sliced chicken.
